name: checkwork
description: منصة مصغرة لإدارة الأعمال والإنجاز — Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name checkwork --branch main
scripts.clean:db: wrangler d1 execute checkwork-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM activity; DELETE FROM task_notes; DELETE FROM tasks; DELETE FROM todos; DELETE FROM members; DELETE FROM workspaces; DELETE FROM sessions; DELETE FROM users;"
